topic: The Digital Transformation of the Chemicals Industry - and How to Prepare
title: The Digital Transformation of the Chemicals Industry - and How to Prepare
session_title: Chemical Engineers Leading in the Era of Industry Digitization (Invited Talks)
abstract: Over the course of the next 20 years, the chemicals industry will see more change than it has in the last 50, in large part due to digital technologies. Digital transformation is affecting business processes from R&D, to manufacturing, to supply chain, to sales and go-to-market -- and the data from all these digital efforts is tying those diverse functions to optimize the chemical enterprise and create new business models and sources of value. This presentation looks at how the industry will change through 2040 and examines what the new sources of competitive advantage will be for both companies and individuals.

title: Driving the Value from Digitalization
session_title: Chemical Engineers Leading in the Era of Industry Digitization (Invited Talks)
abstract: Many opportunities exist to utilize the technologies of Industry 4.0 and digitalization within the process industries, to improve reliability, productivity, profitability, and safety. However, organizations may become enamored with the new tool or capability, looking for problems to fit the technology rather than focusing on the true business needs. Only by being technology agnostic and using a strategy that places balance sheet impact and long term competitive advantage as selection criteria to the myriad of solutions available in the market will an organization focus on the proper challenges. This presentation will examine potential pitfalls to technology selection and implementation.

topic: Combining AI with Chemical Engineering First Principles Will Take Process Performance, Safety and Sustainability to New Levels
title: Combining AI with Chemical Engineering First Principles Will Take Process Performance, Safety and Sustainability to New Levels
session_title: Chemical Engineers Leading in the Era of Industry Digitization (Invited Talks)
abstract: Digitalization is now in the spotlight in terms of creating improved agility, resilience, and ability to operate process industry assets remotely and safely. Sensors, connectivity, and cloud computing are making process data more available for use in optimization and prediction. High performance, edge computing, and new algorithms are enabling placing process models online for monitoring, optimization, and operational advice. Most process and chemical engineers in industry have observed the influx of data science and data scientists into their organizations. This session will cover an area called “hybrid modeling.” This combines and embeds AI and machine learning within first-principles rigorous models. You may think of this as putting chemical engineering guardrails around machine learning. Rigorous, first principles models, brings to bear decades of chemical engineering knowledge. Machine learning and AI brings to bear ability to rapidly analyze, and progressively learn from empirical operating data. When combined, it is now possible to achieve a new level of modeling that will further leverage both types of analysis. We have been validating this breakthrough combination of AI and chemical engineering with over 100 companies in industry, and will cover several high value and immediately practical use cases during this session.

topic: Designing Materials and Processes in the Digital World
title: Designing Materials and Processes in the Digital World
session_title: Chemical Engineers Leading in the Era of Industry Digitization (Invited Talks)
abstract: 3M has been known as a materials innovation company for many years with thousands of new products launched annually, many of those enabling and empowering everyday products. This innovation model is based on leveraging deep technologies into novel combinations to develop product platforms. This talk will address the challenges and progress in transforming this culture and enabling it with digital tools created internally and with outside partners to accelerate the speed of materials innovation dramatically.
